commits.subject: fix(agent): add missing .js extension to init-script import
commits.body:
Node.js ESM requires explicit .js extensions for relative imports.
The import in terminal.ts was missing the extension, causing the
Docker image to fail with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND at runtime.
